name: Arimura Megumi
source:
Hinae and Shingo’s mother.

[Spoiler]Both she and her husband cheated on each other. Hinae was born from one such relationship. 

After Shingo’s death, she and Hinae became estranged.

She lies a lot and because of that, became afraid of Hinae after her powers awakened. She despises Hinae for her life going south. 

On November 1st, she was arrested for the murders of her ex-husband, her lover, a girl whom she mistook for Hinae, and Takuru.[/spoiler]
